basis: ANG-related motor neuron degeneration; muscle wasting results from denervation rather than direct muscle disease.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: amyotrophy and weakness reflect motor neuron loss and denervation, not direct skeletal muscle disease.

basis: Spermatogenic failure affects reproduction. Low testosterone in 1/1 assessed among four reported patients does not establish common persistent endocrine dysfunction.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: low testosterone in one assessed patient does not establish persistent gonadal endocrine failure in at least 30% of this reproductive disorder.

basis: The tumor arises in the prostate, a reproductive organ outside the axes; endothelial histology does not establish cardiovascular organ disease.

decisions.cardiovascular: none: the organ of tumor origin is the prostate; vascular histology alone does not establish disease of the cardiovascular system.

basis: Lysosomal lipid storage with defining late-infantile neurodegeneration; hepatic dysfunction and splenic blood dysfunction are not established in >=30% of this subgroup.

decisions.haematologic: none: splenic storage and enlargement do not by themselves establish impaired blood-organ function; qualifying dysfunction is not established in >=30%.
decisions.hepatic: none: hepatomegaly or storage alone is insufficient; functionally damaging liver disease is not established in >=30% of this neurologic-onset subgroup.

basis: SPG11-related motor neuron degeneration; amyotrophy in 23/23 reflects denervation. Respiratory insufficiency occurs in only 2/23 and reflects muscle weakness.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: amyotrophy in 23/23 is secondary to motor neuron degeneration and denervation, rather than direct skeletal muscle disease.

basis: Hereditary endocrine tumor predisposition; hypertension is reported at 30-79% but depends on manifest tumors. Retinopathy, glomerulosclerosis and stroke are separate complications.

decisions.cardiovascular: none: hypertension reported at 30-79% accompanies manifest secretory tumors; it does not establish direct cardiovascular damage inherent to this predisposition.

basis: Disordered calcium absorption and excretion defines this metabolic condition; urinary calcium alone is not renal damage, and nephrolithiasis is a separate disease.

decisions.renal: none: excessive urinary calcium reflects altered calcium metabolism, not intrinsic renal disease; calcium oxalate nephrolithiasis is a separately diagnosed complication.

basis: Terminal spinal cord malformation with herniation through a spinal dysraphic defect; associated anorectal and genitourinary anomalies are not established in >=30%.

decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: the spinal dysraphic defect permitting cord herniation is part of the malformation; optional sacral agenesis is not the basis for this label.

basis: Developmental epileptic encephalopathy with cerebral atrophy; cerebral visual impairment is neurologic. Astigmatism and esotropia each in 1/2 do not establish direct ocular damage.

decisions.ocular: none: cerebral visual impairment localizes to the brain; astigmatism and esotropia each in 1/2 meet a frequency threshold but do not establish direct ocular damage.

basis: Congenital spinal muscular atrophy identifies a motor neuron disorder; no supplied evidence establishes direct muscle disease or another organ lesion.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: neurogenic muscle wasting results from motor neuron dysfunction; the sparse record provides no evidence of direct skeletal muscle disease.
